test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a row, facing north. No one sits to the right of A. Only four people

sit between D and B. E sits second to the right of D. C sits to the immediate left of F. How many people sit between G and B?
solution:
Given:

Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a row, facing north.

1) No one sits to the right of A.

2) Only four people sit between D and B.

3) E sits second to the right of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1f79aea3e12839e03291914139d9c0f70ac72286b063c37f8ff741d20910988.png] 

4) C sits to the immediate left of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0c9d147a4f75fbe10e40bee0f848005b4306f883d5aca7b99d27f7f2b1c486f.png] 

only 'G' is remaining so final sitting arrangement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2ac8b4e96964ec61eb74c69bcfd35a6d2aebf370a9a53af33d9f3a99abb7da9.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option (1)".**
